description: Strom-Versorgungsnetz der Stadtwerke Hameln-Weserbergland GmbH is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by stwhw-netze.de. The power supply network of Stadtwerke Hameln-Weserbergland includes the low- and medium-voltage lines of the municipalities of Stadt Hameln, Stadt Hessisch Oldendorf, Flecken Aerzen, Flecken Coppenbrügge, Flecken Salzhemmendorf and Flecken Emmerthal. Its keywords include städtische Stromversorgung, Strom, Niederspannung, Elektromobilität, Produktions- und Industrieanlagen, inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
